753:t_008:8.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「An eternity that produces nothing... A prison that goes by the name of a paradise where the $$御使い$$s dwell...」

753:t_008:9.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Sitting there and spending an eternity in idleness is the very sin of the $$御使い$$s.」

753:t_008:11.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Corrupted by the comfort they had won, they spent 120 million years without any progress whatsoever. They can be summed up in one word: hideous.」

753:t_008:12.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But I broke free of that. And to save all the universes, I was reborn as a being that surpasses the $$御使い$$s.」

753:t_008:13.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Together with this $$至高神Ｚ$$!」

753:t_008:16.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That is a name from the bygone past... one that perishes along with the old world. It falls just a little short of guiding us to the new world... a future filled with hope and light.」

753:t_008:17.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「The world that began with Alpha was meant to reach its end here as Omega, but a slight trigger transformed it into Z.」

753:t_008:18.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$至高神Ｚ$$... There could be no name more fitting for a god who will end the world once.」

753:t_008:19.en:
$$アルト$$
「Do you seriously accept the great collapse of the universe!」

753:t_008:20.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I think it's a shame too.」

753:t_008:21.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But what 120 million years of time produced is a universe filled with imperfect life.」

753:t_008:22.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Twisted evolution gave rise to hideous evil gods and ravenous destroyers, and the rest of life never attained $$シンカ$$.」

753:t_008:23.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That is why I agreed with the will of the universe, and reached the conclusion that everything should be returned to nothing once, and started over from there.」

753:t_008:24.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I welcome the ruin of the universe. With the greatest of joy.」

753:t_008:25.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「What selfish reasoning! You who refused to accept humanity's evolution have no right to say such words!」

753:t_008:26.en:
$$シャア$$
「I understand now...! You feared that humans other than yourselves would evolve... then attain $$シンカ$$ and catch up with you!」

753:t_008:27.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Your joy, your anger, your sorrow, your pleasure, all of it was born of self-righteousness and arrogance! You were just drunk on your own emotions from up high!」

753:t_008:28.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I accept those words, my beloved ones.」

753:t_008:30.en:
$$クェス$$
「No way...! I thought he'd desperately deny it!」

753:t_008:31.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That is nothing other than because we were a feeble existence. The $$御使い$$s were a sinful race that halted $$シンカ$$ 120 million years ago.」

753:t_008:32.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「In fact, $$サクリファイ$$ denied herself, and $$ドクトリン$$ and $$テンプティ$$ were driven to the brink of defeat by $$ゼロ$$'s life-or-death $$ギアス$$...」

753:t_008:33.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Had I been as I was until recently, I too would have been trapped by the barrier you prepared.」

753:t_008:35.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That is why I became a being that surpasses the $$御使い$$s, and I affirm my power, my existence... all of myself.」

753:t_008:36.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I am no longer an emissary of God... I have no intention of belittling myself, cloaked in a veneer of modesty like the $$御使い$$s.」

753:t_008:37.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「With my own sense of responsibility and awareness, I will become a god.」

753:t_008:38.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「A smile like the sun, without a speck of cloud...」

753:t_008:39.en:
$$カズミ$$
「I can't sense even a shred of hesitation from him!」

753:t_008:40.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This is it...! This is exactly it!」

753:t_008:42.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This attitude of thinking they're the greatest and the most right! That's exactly why I hate these guys!」

753:t_008:43.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A god!? I can't stand anyone who can say that without a shred of shame!」

753:t_008:44.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「The one who received the power of the $$黒の英知$$, a fragment of $$太極$$, $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$...」

753:t_008:45.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You, who use every means for your own purpose and defy me, may live on as a devil.」

753:t_008:46.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A devil suits me fine! To beat you, I'll do anything!」

753:t_008:47.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I knew you would say that. But it will end in vain.」

753:t_008:48.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Above all, there is very little time left before this universe ends.」

753:t_008:51.en:
$n
「How can you be so arrogant!? If you're a god, can you just watch while every life but your own perishes!?」

753:t_008:52.en:
$n
「Doesn't it hurt you!? Countless lives will be lost because of what you decided!?」

753:t_008:53.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Only by bearing that pain... no, precisely because one can bear it, does one earn the qualification of a god.」

753:t_008:54.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「To truly save the universe, I am prepared to endure every pain and suffering. Believing that someday it will become joy.」

753:t_008:55.en:
$$シン$$
「Shut up! You only went along with the will of the universe or whatever because you get to survive!」

753:t_008:56.en:
$$刹那$$
「You are... distorted! More than anything else!」

753:t_008:57.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Those who destroy galaxies out of anger or for fun were the worst, but one who does it gladly goes even further beyond them!」

753:t_008:58.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Even those words from you, my beloved ones, cannot move me.」

753:t_008:59.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I will guide the force that seeks to vanish to collapse the universe, and afterward guide the force that seeks to exist...」

753:t_008:60.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「To that end, you, brimming with the power of life, will set out for the far edge of the causal horizon, right here.」

753:t_008:61.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「In words you can understand, it means complete annihilation.」

753:t_009:1.en:
$$ギミー$$
「So that's the power that protects that guy!」

753:t_009:2.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Then we'll just blow it away!」

753:t_009:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「Hang on, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I'll smash you along with that prized hunk of yours!」

753:t_009:4.en:
$$桂$$
「I'll take you down and stop the great collapse of the universe! Let's settle this the simple way!」

753:t_009:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「...I don't think you are fools. Since you defeated $$ヴィルダーク$$, $$アサキム$$ and $$プロディキウム$$, it is only natural that you got the wrong idea.」

753:t_009:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But what stands before your eyes is the Supreme God. The power produced by eight $$スフィア$$s and four eternities far exceeds your imagination.」

753:t_009:8.en:
$$トライア$$
「You're wilting already, AG! Never mind that, analyze the state of the dimensional boundary line!」

753:t_009:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Y-Yes! At this rate, in five minutes the universe will no longer be able to maintain its existence, and spacetime will collapse!」

753:t_009:11.en:
$$カグラ$$
「You're saying the universe will perish in five minutes!」

753:t_009:12.en:
$$アマタ$$
「So we have no choice but to defeat $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ by then!」

753:t_009:14.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes! Now is the time to put everything on the line!」

753:t_009:15.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Yes! Now is the time to put everything on the line!」

753:t_009:16.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Yes! Now is the time to put everything on the line!」

753:t_009:17.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「His power is an unknown quantity...! We can't tell what kind of tricks he'll use!」

753:t_009:19.en:
$$キラ$$
「We'll do it! For every life in this universe too!」

753:t_009:20.en:
$$万丈$$
「The power of $$カオス・コスモス$$ still remains in this space! We can use $$真化融合$$ too!」

753:t_009:21.en:
$$葵$$
「Then all we have to do is hit him head-on! With everything we and our machines have!」

753:t_009:22.en:
$$トライア$$
「The attack point is right here!」

753:t_010:0.en:
$$トライア$$
「Break through the small fry around it, and focus your attacks on that spot!」
